newsitem.title: INDIA: India zinc rises, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: India zinc rises, other metals steady.

text.p: Zinc prices rose further but nickel was weak and other base metals steady on local markets on Wednesday, dealers said.
Zinc rose 50 rupees to 7,100 rupees per quintal on limited arrivals, shortage of ready stock and stray speculative buying following an uptrend in the global markets, they said.
"Demand was low but limited offerings by the state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd. kept market firm," a dealer said.
Nickel fell 100 rupees to 37,100 rupees per quintal on fresh arrivals which prompted profit-taking.
Other metals were steady with tin at 34,100 rupees, lead at 4,550 rupees and aluminium at 7,250 rupees per quintal in dull trade.
Copper was steady at 12,900 rupees per quintal on reduced arrivals but industrial buying was sluggish and volume low, dealers said.
Copper was down 50 rupees per quintal on Tuesday. It was down 100 rupees per quintal last week.
